#!/bin/sh
# Append one UTC timestamp line every 30s, 11 lines total (t=0..300s).
cd "$(dirname "$0")" || exit 1
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 11 ]; do
  ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  printf '%s\n' "$ts" >> heartbeat.log
  if [ "$i" -lt 11 ]; then
    sleep 30
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done
printf 'finished\n%s\n' "$ts" > done.txt
```
